hero.heading: Where AGL works
hero.body: Operations where the pallet is load-bearing infrastructure, not a line item.

industries.heading: Building materials
industries.body: Lumber, stone, roofing, and construction components. Heavy, dense, often irregular, and frequently stored outdoors.

industries.heading: Chemicals & coatings
industries.body: Drums, totes, and bulk containers where load stability isn't optional.

industries.heading: Refractories, foundry, glass & clay
industries.body: Extreme point loads and weights most standard specs aren't rated for.

industries.heading: Shipping, distribution & 3PL
industries.body: High throughput, multiple ship-to points, and mixed specs across sites.

industries.heading: Metal fabrication & forging
industries.body: Engineered skids and crates for parts that outweigh the pallet several times over.

industries.heading: Energy & industrial
industries.body: Oil, gas, and electrical equipment, including export crating.

industries.heading: Plastics & packaging
industries.body: High volume, fast cycles, and automated handling.

industries.heading: Food & beverage
industries.body: Throughput operations where a late load stops a line.

ctaBand.heading: Let's talk about your pallet supply.
ctaBand.body: Send a spec and a quantity, or just call and describe the problem.
